name: k6 framework-person matrix
tagline: Load / stress / spike / soak / ceiling matrix for person Query APIs.
description: Python matrix runner builds shared TypeScript clients, runs selected k6 scenarios, then refreshes the load-test dashboard via build_manifests.py --k6-only. Scenario details and env vars live in the hand-maintained k6/framework-person/README.md.

commands.blurb: One VU / one iteration per selected test
Saturation runs with cache-hit request shapes

notes: TEST_FILTER accepts comma-separated keywords (same as CLI args)
CONTINUE_ON_FAILURE=true keeps going after a failed scenario
